falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 3.5% above its close on the signal date and ends the window above its prior 20-day high, while the share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day moving average rises by at least 8 percentage points.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini_top_2019_jun analog failed. Price and breadth confirmed continuation, so UNKNOWN phase and HOLD were wrong; the call should have been bullish continuation.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 4.0% below its close on the signal date, the VIX closes above 24 on at least three sessions, and US high-yield OAS widens by at least 50 basis points from the signal-date level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The suspected mini-top resolved into a confirmed risk-off break. HOLD/UNKNOWN missed an observable directional selloff and should have been a risk-off call.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the US 10-year yield moves at least 35 basis points from its signal-date close in either direction, the 2s10s spread changes by at least 20 basis points, and S&P 500 10-day realized volatility exceeds 22%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rates-and-volatility regime shift large enough to resolve phase uncertainty occurred, falsifying both UNKNOWN and HOLD because the tape no longer matches an unresolved mini-top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
